displayName: Canonical roll-stock service (Spring Boot 3 + JUnit 5 + Mockito)
description: Java/Spring mirror of the dotnet8 canonical-rollstock archetype. Produces a buildable Maven module: roll-stock service + DTOs + JPA-style repository interface + event-publisher interface + stub adapter + JUnit 5 fixtures. Same claim-to-file mapping as the .NET 8 reference — proves the archetype registry is target-stack agnostic.
platformReadiness: Skeleton + a service stub + a test stub ship in-tree. Filling out the remaining files (DTO records, repository interface, event-publisher interface, adapter stub) follows the same pattern as the dotnet8 reference — engagement-time activity.
